housing.summary: Bern, Switzerland's capital, has moderate rent levels. Average 1-BR city-centre apartments run ~CHF 1,551/month per Numbeo (Aug 2026). Swiss law caps the rental deposit at 3 months' rent. Main portals: homegate.ch, comparis.ch, immoscout24.ch.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Switzerland, residents need valid ID, proof of Swiss residence registration (Anmeldebestätigung), and a residence/work permit (non-EU). Main banks in Bern: UBS and Bernische Kantonalbank (BEKB). PostFinance headquarters are in Bern; branches nationwide. Raiffeisen is also present.
required_docs: Employer letter or salary slip (sometimes required)

schools.summary: Bern has several international school options, including Bern International School (BIS) which is the main IB-accredited institution. The Swiss diplomatic and federal administration community sustains demand for bilingual education. The canton's public schools are German-language.

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers must register at the Einwohnerdienste Bern (residents' registration) within 14 days of arrival. EU/EFTA nationals register for permit B or L at the Migrationsdienst Kanton Bern. Non-EU nationals need a permit from the cantonal authority. Authority: sem.admin.ch.
legal_admin.registration_step: Anmeldung at Einwohnerkontrolle within 14 days; residence permit from cantonal migration authority

tax_finance.summary: The AHV-Nummer (OASI number) serves as the Swiss tax and social insurance ID, assigned by the SVA Bern (cantonal compensation office) or employer. Canton Bern has one of the higher cantonal tax burdens in Switzerland. Withholding tax (Quellensteuer) applies for foreign residents without a C-permit.

transport.summary: Bern's public transport is operated by BERNMOBIL (trams, buses) and RBS (regional rail), part of the Libero fare network. A monthly city zone pass costs approximately CHF 82 per Numbeo data. EU/EFTA driving licences are exchangeable within 12 months at the Strassenverkehrs- und Schifffahrtsamt (SVSA Bern) without a driving test. Mandatory Krankenversicherung must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; regulated by BAG/OFSP.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EFTA licences exchangeable within 12 months at SVSA Bern (svsa.ch); non-EU licences generally require theory and/or practical test
transport.healthcare_registration: Mandatory basic health insurance (Krankenversicherung/KVG) must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; choose a licensed insurer at bag.admin.ch
